malay4.title: നിയമലംഘനം ചോദ്യം ചെയ്തതിൽ പ്രകോപനം; തെറ്റായ ദിശയിലെത്തിയ ബസ് പിക്കപ്പ് വാനിലിടിപ്പിച്ചു: ഗതാഗത കമ്മീഷണർ... - Marunadan Malayali

malay4.title: മന്ത്രി ബിന്ദു കൃഷ്ണയുടെ തലയില്‍ ചൂട് പായസം വീണു; സംഭവം പ്രിയദര്‍ശിനി യാത്ര ഉദ്ഘാടനത്തിനിടെ - Marunadan Malayali

malay4.title: 'ഒരുമാസം ഈ ബസില്‍ പോയാല്‍ അവര്‍ സേവ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് എത്രയാണ്? ആ തുക ഒരു മാസം അഡീഷണല്‍ വരുമാനമായി... - Marunadan Malayali
malay4.description: 'ഒരുമാസം ഈ ബസില്‍ പോയാല്‍ അവര്‍ സേവ് ചെയ്യുന്നത് എത്രയാണ്? ആ തുക ഒരു മാസം അഡീഷണല്‍ വരുമാനമായി...    Marunadan Malayali

malay4.title: 'ലഹരി സംഘങ്ങളുമായി അടുത്ത ബന്ധമുള്ളയാള്‍ ആഭ്യന്തരമന്ത്രിയുടെ സ്റ്റാഫില്‍'; അപമാനകരമെന്ന് ഡിവൈഎഫ്‌ഐ - Marunadan Malayali
malay4.description: 'ലഹരി സംഘങ്ങളുമായി അടുത്ത ബന്ധമുള്ളയാള്‍ ആഭ്യന്തരമന്ത്രിയുടെ സ്റ്റാഫില്‍'; അപമാനകരമെന്ന് ഡിവൈഎഫ്‌ഐ    Marunadan Malayali

malay4.title: തമിഴ്‌നാട്ടില്‍ വനിതാ പോലിസുകാരി കൂട്ടബലാത്സംഗത്തിന് ഇരയായി; കാമുകനടക്കം മൂ്ന്നു പേര്‍ അറസ്റ്റില്‍ - Marunadan Malayali

japan1.title: 株価 終値も初の6万9000円台 アメリカとイラン 協議合意伝わり
japan1.description: 週明けの15日の東京株式市場、アメリカとイランが戦闘終結に向けた協議で合意したことを背景に幅広い銘柄に買い注文が集まり、日経平均株価は6万9317円50銭で取り引きを終え、終値として初めて6万9000円台をつけました。先週末の終値と比べた値上がり幅は3200円あまりとなり、終値としてこれまでで2番目の大きさとなりました。

japan1.title: きょうのおはBiz6月15日(月) 国債買い入れペース どう見直す
japan1.description: NHKニュース「おはよう日本」で平日朝に放送している経済ニュースコーナー「おはBiz」。最新のビジネストレンドや働き方、お役立ちサービスやスタートアップ企業の情報など、ギュギュっとコンパクトにお届けします。

japan1.title: NY原油市場 80ドル台に下落 米イラン合意で供給回復に期待感
japan1.description: 14日のニューヨーク原油市場では、国際的な取り引きの指標となるWTIの先物価格が一時、1バレル＝80ドル台まで下落しました。先週末と比べると5％あまり下落した形です。アメリカのトランプ大統領がイランとの戦闘終結に向けた協議について合意し、ホルムズ海峡が開放されると明らかにしたことで、投資家の間では中東からの原油などの供給が回復するとの期待感が高まっています。

japan1.title: 日銀 きょうから金融政策決定会合 利上げを最終判断へ
japan1.description: 日銀は15日から2日間、金融政策決定会合を開きます。植田総裁が入院中のため欠席する異例の会合となりますが、イラン情勢の影響で原油高や円安傾向が続く中、物価上昇への対応を急ぐ必要があるとして、利上げに踏み切ることを最終判断する見通しです。

japan1.title: 米FRBウォーシュ新議長のもと初会合へ 発言に関心集まる
japan1.description: アメリカのFRB＝連邦準備制度理事会は、今週、16日からトランプ大統領に指名されたウォーシュ新議長のもとで初めてとなる、金融政策を決める会合を開きます。イラン情勢を背景とした物価の上昇を抑えるためFRBが年内にも利上げに踏み切るとの見方が金融市場で出る中、ウォーシュ新議長の会合後の記者会見での発言に関心が集まっています。

japan1.title: 「スペースX」が上場 調達資金 約12兆円は過去最大規模
japan1.description: アメリカの実業家、イーロン・マスク氏が率い、宇宙開発やAI事業を手がける「スペースX」は12日、ニューヨークのナスダック市場に上場しました。上場による調達額はおよそ750億ドル、日本円にしておよそ12兆円と過去最大の規模となります。

japan1.title: ウリ信用組合に一部業務停止命令 顧客の預金着服などで 金融庁

bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bang3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bang3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it

ca3.title: Rural Ontario communities reeling with grief after crash that killed 5 children
ca3.description: Rural Ontario communities are reeling with grief after a deadly crash on Friday took the lives of five children in one family from a town near Kitchener-Waterloo. The township's mayor says many in the area are turning to religion to reckon with the loss.

ca3.title: B.C. community reports high demand for rural permanent residency program
ca3.description: The Rural Community Immigration Pilot allows small communities across Canada to recommend people with skills and jobs in selected sectors for permanent residency.

ca3.title: B.C. woman who survived avalanche says it was like 'being hit by a truck'
ca3.description: Hannah Hughes was backcountry skiing in Norway when she looked up to see a wall of snow barreling towards her. She now faces a long recovery from her injuries.

ca3.title: Pro-separation billboard still up after removal deadline from Alberta town passes
ca3.description: Cory Morgan says the sign he paid for is still standing in Taber, Alta., in defiance of a letter he says the town sent earlier this month to the private owner of the billboard demanding the message be removed by Saturday.

ca3.title: Socceroos score big over Turkey in Vancouver's 2026 World Cup hosting debut
ca3.description: Australia win Group D match with great goalkeeping and a stout defence.

ca3.title: Just how many days do provincial politicians spend legislating? We did the math
ca3.description: Some politicians say the number of days spent in the legislature doesn't matter too much, because the most important work is done in their constituency offices. Others say less time in legislatures allows provincial and territorial governments to avoid accountability and pass flawed legislation.

ca3.title: A more conciliatory Ford says 'I love the U.S.' as trade talks loom
ca3.description: Doug Ford appears to be throttling back on aggressive anti-Trump rhetoric with key trade talks looming with the U.S., stepping up a charm offensive aimed at politicians and lobby groups in the mercurial president’s orbit.

ca3.title: 5 children killed in a crash near Kitchener-Waterloo, Ont.
ca3.description: Five children between the ages of four and 12 were killed in a two-vehicle collision in rural Ontario, according to OPP. Several others, including one infant, were injured.

ca3.title: Wolves, winter and frostbite: Why 2 Nova Scotians walked to Vancouver in 1921
ca3.description: Just over a century ago, Jennie Dill was one of the most famous women in Canada. She had just done something no woman had ever done before. She walked across the country.

ca3.title: First pickleball, now padel: Why ‘social’ sports are growing in popularity
ca3.description: While the Mexican sport padel has exploded in popularity in other parts of the world, it has struggled to gain traction in Canada — until within just the last five years. Now, it’s seeing more demand than Canada’s courts can handle.

ca3.title: Canada's newest destroyer carries on legacy of warship lost in 1940 tragedy
ca3.description: The first of Canada's new River-class destroyers will be named HMCS Fraser. In 1940, a previous HMCS Fraser aided in evacuating British and other Allied forces from the French coast, and later became the first Royal Canadian Navy ship to sink during the Second World War.

ca3.title: 'We’ve never seen a spike like this': Veterinary tranquillizer suspected in Moncton, N.B., overdose surge
ca3.description: First responders and front-line workers in the Greater Moncton area are battling an unprecedented, two-week surge in overdoses driven by a suspected contaminant in the local drug supply.

ca3.title: 'The land misses us': How Indigenous land stewardship protects cultural history and forests
ca3.description: Leader of the XAXE TEṈEW̱ Sacred Land Society’s Indigenous land restoration and stewardship program, says Indigenous land stewardship directly help with wildfire prevention. Research from UBC shows it also makes the land healthier.

ca3.title: Montreal mayor urges calm, vows to uncover truth after police unit suspected of racist behaviour
ca3.description: Montreal Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada called for calm and pledged that Montrealers would learn the truth about allegations of co-ordinated racist behaviour in a Montréal-Nord police unit.

ca3.title: New Brunswick woman sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT led to daughter's death
ca3.description: Alice Carrier died by suicide last year. Her mother says OpenAI failed to implement necessary safeguards despite knowing about the state of her daughter's mental health and even reinforced harmful views.

ca3.title: AI cameras being piloted to detect wildfires in Kananaskis
ca3.description: AltaLink is testing AI-enabled wildfire cameras in Kananaskis that can automatically detect smoke and alert staff to potential fire starts. AI wildfire detection cameras are being increasingly being rolled out across western North America as communities look for new ways to detect wildfires quicker.

ca3.title: Canada vows to restrict social media for kids under 16. Teens say they'll 'always find a way'

ca3.title: Brooks residents seek info on the data centre megaproject planned right next door
ca3.description: A substantial but largely confidential plan to build a huge data centre near Brooks, Alta., has led local officials to update bylaws and launch an education program for residents about the benefits, drawbacks and potential mitigation strategies of hosting such large-scale industry.
